evidenceChain.summary: os-core health helper landed; orchestrator-api wired to @nzila/os-core/health.
Generator + validator + CI wiring + post-redeploy proof plan published. Reclassification gated on live evidence.
Revision --0000022 reached Running/Healthy. Live probes captured (live-health-post-redeploy-2026-05-12.json) and codified into the v1 attestation.
Generator regenerated latest JSON consuming the attestation; orchestrator-api moved failing→degraded with evidenceBasis=live_post_redeploy and clearsAfterRedeploy=false.

added.name: post-redeploy-attestation-supersession
added.rationale: Inverse of generator's live_post_redeploy classification path. Prevents the latest JSON from regressing back to failing/clearsAfterRedeploy=true while a v1 attestation artifact exists for the app, and forces the open follow-ups (/ready=503, /=404) to remain mentioned in notes so they cannot be silently dropped.
added.trigger: any file matching /^post-redeploy-runtime-attestation-.*\.json$/ or /^live-health-post-redeploy-.*\.json$/ under reports/runtime/ for the app
assertions: if classification == 'degraded' AND evidenceBasis == 'live_post_redeploy', notes MUST mention '/ready' and '503' (or 'readiness') AND must mention root and '404' (or 'by design')

ready.rationale: queue and storage probes return 'unknown' (not yet wired) and thirdParty.github is 'degraded' (no GITHUB_TOKEN in staging). Per @nzila/os-core/health semantics, this collapses to /ready=503. Truthful by design.
ready.remediation: Wire real queue/storage probes or mark not-applicable; provision non-secret GITHUB_TOKEN. Tracked as Delta-6 candidate. Does not block UE pilot.

root.rationale: orchestrator-api is API-only Fastify; no root route registered. Framework default 404 is expected.
root.remediation: Optional product decision on registering a root JSON banner. Out of scope for Delta-5; tracked as Delta-6 candidate.

generate.result: wrote reports/runtime/runtime-health-status-latest.json apps:20 healthy=6 degraded=4 failing=4 not_instrumented=6

followUps: Wire orchestrator-api /ready queue + storage probes (or mark not-applicable in RuntimeHealthResponse).
Provision non-secret GITHUB_TOKEN in staging ACA env so thirdParty.github != degraded.
Product decision on root '/' JSON banner for API-only services.
Reclassify agrimo / cora once they adopt @nzila/os-core/health.
